parole.testo: a cappella + sang, first part from Italian alla cappella (“in the manner of the [Sistine] chapel”). Last part from Old Norse sǫngr (“song”), from Proto-Germanic *sangwaz (“singing, song”), from Proto-Indo-European *songʷʰos, derived from *singwaną (“to sing”), from Proto-Indo-European *séngʷʰ-e-ti,
